description: A GPO is linked to an OU, domain, or site; the linked scope inherits the GPO's settings.

telemetry.detail: The link is a standing relationship, not an action. It matters only as the reach of a controlled/abused GPO.

abuse_primitive: No action; provides the blast radius for WriteGPLink / GPO control edges.
notes: Near-zero on its own. Path danger comes from controlling the GPO at the other end of the link.
